name: Greenshades
about: Watches Greenshades (tax filing, year-end forms, payroll services); an outage delays payroll tax filing and year-end reporting such as W-2s.
details: Reads Greenshades' status page. Customers file payroll taxes and produce year-end forms such as W-2s through Greenshades, so an outage can delay filings, which matters most near deadlines.
label: :page_facing_up: *Greenshades Status*
